prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury lawyer in Houston for a car wreck?
competitors_mentioned: Board Certified in Personal Injury Trial Law
State Bar of Texas Lawyer Referral
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” Houston car-wreck lawyer—the right choice depends on injury severity, insurance coverage, liability disputes, and whether the lawyer actually tries cases.

For a serious Houston collision, prioritize a lawyer who:

- Is **Board Certified in Personal Injury Trial Law** by the Texas Board of Legal Specialization.
- Regularly handles **auto/trucking collision cases**, not just general legal work.
- Has real **trial experience** and is willing to litigate rather than quickly settle.
- Personally reviews your case instead of handing everything to a case manager.
- Works on a clear **contingency fee** agreement and explains costs.
- Has no conflict with another driver, insurer, or involved company.

Good places to verify candidates:
- **Texas Board of Legal Specialization** attorney directory  
- **State Bar of Texas Lawyer Referral & Information Service**
- Court-record searches and verified client reviews—while treating ads and “top lawyer” lists cautiously.

When you call, ask: “How many car-wreck cases like mine have you taken to trial?” “Who will handle my file day-to-day?” and “What percentage fee and case costs apply if we lose?”

Also, Texas generally has a **two-year deadline** to file most personal-injury claims from a wreck, though exceptions can apply. Avoid anyone who contacts you unsolicited immediately after a crash; Texas restricts improper accident solicitation.

If you have severe injuries, a commercial truck involved, a drunk-driving claim, a disputed-fault crash, or inadequate insurance, it is especially worthwhile to consult a board-certified Houston personal-injury trial lawyer promptly.
